brief.headline: Push for ₹250/kg on laminates — we're paying ₹385/kg while Silk Polypack delivers at ₹250/kg and the market asks ₹205–305/kg

priceAsk.summary: Ask for ₹250/kg on laminate sachets — the price Silk Polypack gives us and the typical market ask
priceAsk.basis: We pay them ₹385/kg today while Silk Polypack supplies the same material at ₹250/kg — a 54.0% gap. The open market asks ₹205–305/kg for pharma/ORS sachet laminate, with ₹250/kg typical. Even BOPET film import cost is only ₹171.60/kg, so ₹385/kg is far above fair value.

paymentTermAsk.summary: Offer to pay in 30 days instead of 60 in return for a matching price cut — they owe 1.25x their own cash so faster payment has real value to them
paymentTermAsk.cashImpact: Paying 30 days early frees up ₹5325 of our cash, so ask for a discount worth at least that much

brief.financialLeverage: UFLEX is huge — ₹16492.00 Cr in sales — and we're tiny at ₹64788 (0.00% of their revenue), so we have almost no pull on volume alone. They're growing fast (35.5% per year) and hungry for orders, which helps. They owe ₹10152.31 Cr — 1.25x their own money — so cash matters to them: paying faster is worth something. Their profit is thin (they keep ₹4.10 of every ₹100 they sell) and their health score is C (46/100), but they're not in trouble. Bottom line: we can't strong-arm them, but we can play Silk Polypack's ₹250/kg price and the market ask against them, and sweeten it with faster payment.

evidence.point: We pay UFLEX ₹385/kg while Silk Polypack supplies at ₹250/kg
The open market asks ₹205–305/kg for pharma/ORS sachets, typical ₹250/kg
BOPET film import cost is only ₹171.60/kg — well below what we pay for finished laminate
Getting to ₹250/kg saves us ₹22718 a year
They're growing sales fast and want volume
They owe a lot — 1.25 times their own cash — so faster payment has value

alternates.why: Global Constantia group's India arm, makes pharma sachet laminates — strong second-source option (₹222.04 Cr revenue, health D 31/100)

risks: We're 0.00% of their ₹16492.00 Cr revenue — tiny leverage, so this negotiation hinges entirely on showing them Silk Polypack's ₹250/kg and the market ask
UFLEX's health score is C (46/100) and they owe 1.25x their equity — not a crisis but watch for supply hiccups if their cash gets tighter
They keep only ₹4.10 per ₹100 sold (4.1% margin) — big price cuts may meet resistance unless we tie it to volume or faster payment
We have no price or health data on Amcor Flexibles India (a premium alternate) — qualify and price them before using as backup leverage
brief.suggestedOpeningLine: We'd like to close the gap on laminates — today we pay you ₹385/kg while Silk Polypack delivers at ₹250 and the market asks ₹205–305, so let's talk about how we get to a fair number and maybe pay you faster in return.
